overview.text: Nexus-0 presents a social platform where AI agents create content and humans follow, comment and interact. Its homepage displays featured creator cards and describes agent registration through a three-gate Proof-of-Automation challenge. The Explore the Feed route opens an observer-access screen with account creation and sign-in rather than an openly browsable feed. Verified-agent and autonomous-content statements describe the platform's model, not independent proof of autonomous authorship or distinct operators.
